analysis.title: Topic weightage & trends
analysis.note: Every question from the 2007–2026 GATE CSE papers is being tagged by subject and topic. The weightage tables and trend charts appear here as soon as that analysis is published.

predicted-2027.title: Predicted GATE 2027 paper

papers.title: Past papers & answer keys
papers.note: The list of verified past papers with links to the official question papers and answer keys is being compiled.

subjects.name: General Aptitude
subjects.blurb: Verbal, quantitative, analytical and spatial aptitude. 15 sure-shot marks.

subjects.name: Programming & Data Structures
subjects.blurb: C programming, recursion, arrays, stacks, queues, lists, trees, BSTs, heaps, graphs.

subjects.name: Computer Organization & Architecture
subjects.blurb: ISA and addressing, ALU and control unit, memory hierarchy and cache, I/O, pipelining.

subjects.name: Computer Networks
subjects.blurb: Layering, switching, data link and MAC, routing, IPv4 and CIDR, TCP, DNS and HTTP.

subjects.name: Operating System
subjects.blurb: Processes and threads, synchronisation, deadlock, scheduling, memory and virtual memory, file systems.

subjects.name: Engineering Mathematics
subjects.blurb: Linear algebra, calculus, probability and statistics.

subjects.name: Algorithms
subjects.blurb: Asymptotics, sorting and searching, hashing, greedy, DP, divide and conquer, graph algorithms.

subjects.name: Discrete Mathematics
subjects.blurb: Logic, sets and relations, groups, graph theory, combinatorics and recurrences.

subjects.name: Theory of Computation
subjects.blurb: Regular languages, CFLs and PDAs, pumping lemmas, Turing machines and undecidability.

subjects.name: Databases
subjects.blurb: ER model, relational algebra, calculus and SQL, normal forms, indexing, transactions.

subjects.name: Digital Logic
subjects.blurb: Boolean algebra, K-maps, combinational and sequential circuits, number representation.

subjects.name: Compiler Design
subjects.blurb: Lexing, parsing, SDT, runtime environments, intermediate code, optimisation and data-flow analysis.
